name: Open-CUAK
description: Open-source platform for running and managing browser-automation agents (computer-use agents) at scale, self-hostable with Docker.

name: BookmarkForge
description: Local-first encrypted vault for bookmarks and notes with free smart search. MIT core; Pro features are paid and proprietary.

name: loopsmith
description: Rust CLI that runs a repeatable task as a self-correcting agent loop, finished only when a deterministic checker, not the AI, passes.

name: System One SDK
description: TypeScript SDK for AI-agent decision layers, with adapters for the hosted System One API or your own local model runtimes.

name: artgen-effects
description: Open-source image effects for pixel art, ASCII art, and risograph-style prints in the browser.
